headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,400 AS JULY CPI TAMES RATE FEARS — FED SEPTEMBER HIKE ODDS FALL TO 35%, SILVER SOARS 2.5%
snippet: July US Consumer Price Index came in at +3.4% year-on-year headline and +2.5% core — matching consensus estimates across the board — giving bulls the 'soft landing, soft inflation' narrative needed to extend gold's payrolls-driven rally. Spot gold rose 1.24% to $4,424 and silver surged 2.51% to $66.20 as Federal Reserve September rate-hike odds fell further to approximately 35%, down from near 65% a month ago. The tame CPI print confirms a weakening labor and inflation backdrop (July nonfarm payrolls: −23,000 vs. +180,000 consensus), and analysts are watching whether gold can extend toward $4,481–$4,500 resistance. Additional support came from ongoing geopolitical tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, with gold remaining above its 52-week moving average for the third consecutive session — a technical confirmation that is increasingly drawing institutional follow-through buying.

headline: APEX CRITICAL METALS DRILLS BEST-EVER: 5.27% REO OVER 10.2m AND 2.42% REO OVER 151m AT NEBRASKA CARBONATITE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Apex Critical Metals Corp. (CSE: APXC)
snippet: Apex Critical Metals Corp. (CSE: APXC) released assay results on August 12, 2026 from holes RIFT26-011 through RIFT26-014 at its Rift Rare Earth Project in the Elk Creek Carbonatite Complex, southeastern Nebraska. Headline hole RIFT26-012, drilled 100 metres west of the discovery area, returned 2.42% REO over 151.4 metres — the company's strongest grade-width combination to date — including the highest-grade intervals yet drilled: 5.27% REO over 10.2 metres and 4.48% REO over 8.0 metres, described as the strongest intercept south of the discovery area. Results from RIFT26-012 and RIFT26-014 confirm the Trinity Zone is expanding down-dip and to the west beyond previously drilled limits, with all four new holes intersecting >2.00% REO over 150-metre-plus intervals, signalling that the zone is larger and more continuous than the existing drill pattern captured. The strategic context is maximum: President Trump's $12 billion Project Vault critical mineral reserve (launched February 2026), the January 1, 2027 executive-order deadline barring Chinese-origin rare earths from US defence procurement, and the USA Rare Earth + Texas Mineral merger completed August 7 all highlight how rare genuine domestic NdPr-bearing carbonatite drill results at these grades and widths have become in the US.

headline: SILVER BREAKS $66 FOR FIRST TIME SINCE JUNE — $67.17 NEXT RESISTANCE, BULLS EYE $72 MOVE
snippet: Silver surpassed $66 per ounce on August 12, 2026 for the first time since June, reaching $66.49 by 7:45 AM ET and extending to $66.71 in midday trading, as the tame July CPI print reinforced the case for a Federal Reserve pause in September. FXStreet technical analysts set a near-term target at $67.17 (next daily chart resistance), with the $71.18–$71.50 band — where the 200-day moving average and a long-term rising trendline converge — representing the primary bull case. Silver's move follows six consecutive years of structural physical deficit (the Silver Institute projects a 148.9 million ounce supply gap in 2024–2025 that has carried into 2026), with industrial demand from solar panel manufacturing, EV systems, and AI data centre infrastructure all accelerating. At a gold-silver ratio now near 66x against the long-run average of 60.5x since 1971, silver remains historically undervalued relative to gold and may deliver higher percentage gains if the ratio continues to compress.

headline: NINE MILE METALS NINE: 3.49% CuEq OVER 24.55m CONFIRMS VMS LENS AT NEW SOUTHWEST COLLAR, WEDGE MINE NB
source_name: Investing News Network / Nine Mile Metals Ltd. (CSE: NINE)
snippet: Nine Mile Metals Ltd. (CSE: NINE) released certified assay results on August 12, 2026 for drillhole DDH WD-26-09 at the Wedge Mine in the Bathurst Mining Camp, New Brunswick — one of Canada's most historically productive copper-zinc-lead-silver-gold VMS camps. Hole WD-26-09 was collared at the southwest edge of the current drill pattern and returned 3.49% copper equivalent (CuEq) over 24.55 metres, including 4.03% CuEq over 16.50 metres and 5.22% CuEq over 6.50 metres within a massive sulphide lens carrying copper, lead, zinc, silver, and gold. The intersection confirms VMS mineralisation at the new southwestern limit of the deposit — extending the known envelope beyond the existing resource footprint. Nine Mile is conducting its largest-ever programme at Wedge with 10,000 metres planned across multiple targets and a rig committed through year-end; an updated NI 43-101 technical report incorporating all 2024–2026 drill data is expected by autumn 2026. A resource estimate incorporating these results, at current copper above $6.60 per pound, will materially de-risk the project.

headline: KINROSS GOLD RETURNS TO WILLIAMS BROOK — PUMA.V JAGUAR ZONE GETS 2,000m DRILL PROGRAM, MAJOR VALIDATES DISCOVERY
source_name: Newsfile Corp / Puma Exploration Inc. (TSX-V: PUMA)
snippet: Puma Exploration Inc. (TSX-V: PUMA) announced on August 12, 2026 that Kinross Gold Corp. has returned to the Williams Brook Gold Project in New Brunswick for its second drill campaign of 2026, launching a 2,000-metre programme at the Jaguar Gold Zone beginning July 26. The programme comprises seven holes (200–500 metres each) targeting the Jaguar core and step-out testing additional geophysical anomalies approximately 500 metres away. The most recent Kinross result — hole WB26-195 — returned a wide 0.45 g/t gold over 56.50 metres including 1.03 g/t gold over 16.0 metres coincident with a surface IP anomaly. Kinross optioned Williams Brook from Puma in October 2024 and has now committed two substantive drill programmes in 2026 — a major gold producer sustaining this level of earned-interest work at gold above $4,400 is a strong validation signal for a discovery-stage project. Williams Brook sits in New Brunswick's Appalachian gold belt, a jurisdiction with active permitting and low community opposition to exploration.

headline: KODIAK COPPER KDK: 900m IP ANOMALY AT MPD SOUTH BC — POSSIBLE FAULT-DISPLACED EXTENSION OF ENTIRE PORPHYRY SYSTEM
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSX-V: KDK)
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSX-V: KDK) announced on August 11–12, 2026 that its 3D Induced Polarization survey at the MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia has identified a large untested chargeability anomaly spanning 900 metres adjacent to the existing Mineral Resource at the South deposit. The anomaly's geometry and response characteristics are similar to the 3D-IP signature directly associated with the confirmed South deposit porphyry system, and available geological data suggests it may represent a fault-displaced extension of that system — a scenario that would significantly expand the potential resource footprint. Two diamond drill rigs are currently operating on site with 16,500 metres planned for 2026, with drilling expected to continue into Q4; results from holes testing the new anomaly are the next anticipated catalyst. MPD's road-accessible location in B.C.'s Interior, near established copper processing infrastructure, is a meaningful practical advantage as copper trades above US$14,000 per tonne and North American porphyry developers draw increased institutional interest.

headline: KINGFISHER KFR: 4,500m DRILLED IN BC'S GOLDEN TRIANGLE — 3 RIGS ACTIVE AT HANK AND CASH PORPHYRY TARGETS
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kingfisher Metals Corp. (TSX-V: KFR)
snippet: Kingfisher Metals Corp. (TSX-V: KFR) released an exploration update on August 11, 2026 confirming that three diamond drill rigs are active across the HWY 37 and Forrest Kerr Projects in BC's Golden Triangle, with 4,500+ metres drilled in seven holes across the Hank Porphyry-Epithermal and Cash Porphyry targets since the season opened in June. Four holes are completed and three are actively drilling; field crews have also collected 2,452 soil samples and advanced IP and airborne geophysical surveys. Assay results have not yet been received — all descriptions are based on core logging — making the pending assay return the key catalytic event. The Golden Triangle is one of the world's most prolific new porphyry-epithermal discovery districts, and Agnico Eagle's June 2026 acquisition of Rupert Resources' 5-million-ounce Ikkari gold deposit in Finland established a fresh valuation data point for major-company appetite toward large porphyry-style gold systems discovered by juniors. A three-rig, fully funded exploration programme in the Golden Triangle — where Seabridge KSM, Treaty Creek and Brucejack define the scale of what the district can produce — is precisely the commitment level that precedes a meaningful discovery announcement.

headline: GDX UP 5 SESSIONS STRAIGHT TO $91.58 — GDXJ GAINS 22% IN A WEEK AS MINERS POST SECOND-BEST EARNINGS IN HISTORY
snippet: The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) extended its win streak to five consecutive sessions on August 12, 2026, trading at $91.58 — up from $83.89 before its 7.15% breakout session on August 7 — as gold above $4,400 and a confirmed tame July CPI print pulled institutional capital back into the gold equity complex. The VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) has now risen 22.42% from its August 7 intraday low to $116.78. The market context justifies the re-rating: Q2 2026 earnings season has delivered the second-best quarterly results in gold mining history for smaller producers, with AISC costs averaging below $2,000 per ounce across the sector and gold prices above $4,300 throughout the quarter. Torex Gold (TSX: TXG) reported $94 million in Q2 free cash flow; Artemis Gold (TSX-V: ARTG) posted $285 million EBITDA; i-80 Gold (TSX: IAU) tripled year-over-year production. Despite record sector profits, GDX and GDXJ trade at single-digit-to-low-teen P/E multiples — a valuation mismatch that fund managers increasingly describe as the most compelling re-rating opportunity in the resource sector.

headline: VANECK'S CASANOVA: GOLD MINERS PRINTING RECORD FCF AT UNDER $2,000 AISC — 'LONG-OVERDUE' RE-RATING NOW BUILDING
snippet: VanEck gold portfolio manager Imaru Casanova argues in a recent August 2026 analysis that gold miners are demonstrating an ability to sustain strength in the current elevated price environment — with sector AISC holding below $2,000 per ounce despite labour and energy inflation — generating free cash flow yields the sector has rarely produced. The analysis identifies two structural advantages this gold cycle has that prior cycles lacked: significantly stronger balance sheets (the debt-laden crisis mode of 2015–2018 is not being repeated) and disciplined capital allocation (buybacks and dividends are rising; acquisition premiums are smaller). Casanova notes that analysts have increasingly published 2026–2028 gold price forecasts assuming sustained $4,000+ gold — a fundamental repricing of the long-term price deck that is the delayed catalyst for a gold equity re-rating she expects to accelerate through Q3–Q4 2026. For retail investors, the practical consequence is clear: gold above $4,000 permanently changes the NPV and IRR math on development-stage projects, meaning the same assets that looked marginal at $2,200 gold in 2024 now generate strong returns — and the market is only beginning to reprice that reality.

headline: GOLDSEEK: PM SECTOR 'MAJOR NEW UPTREND' CONFIRMED — FALLING WEDGE RESOLVES HIGHER IN 90%+ OF CASES AFTER THIS DURATION
snippet: A GoldSeek contributor published a technical and fundamental case for a major new PM sector uptrend following the August 7 gold stock breakout week, arguing that GDXJ's surge from a month-long falling wedge resolves to the upside in roughly 90% of comparable historical cases — and that the current backdrop provides an unusual convergence of technical and fundamental confirmation. The piece highlights the COT data from the August 7 report showing silver commercials at their smallest net short position in 18 months and gold open interest building on rising prices rather than short covering — structural indicators of institutional, non-speculative accumulation rather than a short-squeeze-driven move that would be more likely to fade. For junior mining investors specifically, the most actionable point is that GDXJ outperforms GDX by a margin of approximately 1.5x in confirmed gold equity bull markets — meaning the leverage embedded in TSX-V and ASX junior explorers vs. mid-tier producers typically widens on the second leg of a gold rally. With gold above $4,400 and the sector technically confirmed, the risk-reward for quality junior explorers is at its most favourable since the January 2026 all-time high run.
